message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No new vulnerabilities were verified as relevant to the normalized DLL/component inventory during the last 24 hours.

**Scope:** `DLL_software_component.txt` only. Duplicate rows and obvious naming variants were normalized; `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` were not read or combined.

**Scan window:** 2026-10-31 13:10 IST through 2026-11-01 13:10 IST (2026-10-31 07:40 UTC through 2026-11-01 07:40 UTC).

### Findings

None. No candidate passed all freshness, product-match, source-credibility, and deduplication checks.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The mandatory dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and major libraries, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, MongoDB-owned notices, CVE/NVD-linked records, GitHub Security Advisories, and CISA sources. [MongoDB's security alert catalog](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts) showed no MongoDB-family advisory published in this scan window; the newest visible vendor entries were dated October 26, 2026.

### Possible matches needing review

None.

### Notable exclusion

[CVE-2026-118147](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-118147), published in-window and rated High, affects Microsoft Visual Studio itself. It was excluded because the DLL inventory lists Microsoft libraries and test packages, not Visual Studio.

### Review priority

No immediate vulnerability review is indicated from this scan. Continue routine monitoring; this result does not replace environment-specific dependency or binary scanning.
